name: Worgen in the Woods
label: Quest
description: Calor sends you against the Nightbane pack in southern Duskwood. Their dens and mines bring the worgen threat close to Darkshire.

clips.title: The story
paras: Calor sends you against the Nightbane pack in southern Duskwood. Their dens and mines bring the worgen threat close to Darkshire.

South of Darkshire, the Nightbane worgen are making fortified camps in caves and abandoned mine shafts. Calor watches their bonfires and fears what their growing hold means for the town. The Vile Fangs and Tainted Ones are among the pack’s fiercest breeds. Their savagery and stubbornness threaten Darkshire’s perimeter.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your previous accomplishments have convinced me that you are ready to take on the toughest worgen infesting the woods.
Of the worgen that have made their new home here, the Vile Fangs and the Tainted Ones have proven the most dangerous. They've settled down near some of the caves and in the mine to the south.
From far away you can even see the light from their bonfires...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Intimidating beasts aren't they? But have no fear, friend, those who stand for the Light will never fall!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend, to be honest with you, I did not believe that you would get this far, but you are clearly an adventurer to be reckoned with. In fact, if you wish to formally join Master Carevin's struggle, I will gladly write for you a letter of recommendation.
